name: Oskarn Unit 159 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Drying Chamber Capacity: 3040-liter drying chamber accommodates high-volume batch processing, ideal for industrial and commercial drying needs. Efficient Moisture Removal: Removes up to 219 kilograms of moisture per day, supporting fast and effective drying for a wide range of materials. Controlled Air Temperature: Operates at a consistent 32°C, ensuring gentle drying that helps preserve product quality and prevents overheating. Vacuum Airflow Pattern: Utilizes a vacuum airflow system to enhance drying efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and improve product uniformity. Batch Drying Process: Designed for 44-hour batch cycles, suitable for materials that require thorough, gradual drying. Customizable Pricing: Unit price determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific requirements. Main Benefits High Capacity & Productivity: Handles large quantities in each batch, reducing downtime and maximizing throughput for busy operations. Energy-Efficient Operation: The vacuum airflow system and moderate drying temperature work together to lower energy usage and operational costs. Consistent, Quality Results: Uniform drying conditions help maintain the integrity, texture, and value of sensitive products. Flexible Application: Suitable for a variety of industries, including food processing, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture, where precise moisture control is critical. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Bulk Drying of Food Ingredients: Ideal for dehydrating fruits, vegetables, herbs, and grains while preserving nutritional content and flavor. Pharmaceutical Material Processing: Supports gentle drying of powders, granules, and other sensitive compounds. Agricultural Product Preservation: Efficiently removes moisture from seeds, nuts, and other agricultural goods to extend shelf life and prevent spoilage. Industrial Material Drying: Suitable for processing chemicals, minerals, and other industrial materials that require controlled drying environments. User Questions Addressed Is this dryer suitable for large-scale operations? Yes, the 3040-liter chamber and high moisture removal rate make it ideal for industrial-scale drying. How does the vacuum airflow improve drying? Vacuum airflow promotes even moisture removal and can reduce energy consumption compared to standard airflow patterns. What materials can be dried? This dryer is compatible with a wide range of products, including food, pharmaceuticals, agricultural goods, and industrial materials. Is the drying process gentle on sensitive materials? The controlled 32°C air temperature and batch operation help protect delicate products from heat damage.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Drying Chamber Capacity: 3040-liter drying chamber accommodates high-volume batch processing, ideal for industrial and commercial drying needs.
  • Efficient Moisture Removal: Removes up to 219 kilograms of moisture per day, supporting fast and effective drying for a wide range of materials.
  • Controlled Air Temperature: Operates at a consistent 32°C, ensuring gentle drying that helps preserve product quality and prevents overheating.
  • Vacuum Airflow Pattern: Utilizes a vacuum airflow system to enhance drying efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and improve product uniformity.
  • Batch Drying Process: Designed for 44-hour batch cycles, suitable for materials that require thorough, gradual drying.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific requirements.

Main Benefits

  • High Capacity & Productivity: Handles large quantities in each batch, reducing downtime and maximizing throughput for busy operations.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation: The vacuum airflow system and moderate drying temperature work together to lower energy usage and operational costs.
  • Consistent, Quality Results: Uniform drying conditions help maintain the integrity, texture, and value of sensitive products.
  • Flexible Application: Suitable for a variety of industries, including food processing, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture, where precise moisture control is critical.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Bulk Drying of Food Ingredients: Ideal for dehydrating fruits, vegetables, herbs, and grains while preserving nutritional content and flavor.
  • Pharmaceutical Material Processing: Supports gentle drying of powders, granules, and other sensitive compounds.
  • Agricultural Product Preservation: Efficiently removes moisture from seeds, nuts, and other agricultural goods to extend shelf life and prevent spoilage.
  • Industrial Material Drying: Suitable for processing chemicals, minerals, and other industrial materials that require controlled drying environments.

User Questions Addressed

  • Is this dryer suitable for large-scale operations? Yes, the 3040-liter chamber and high moisture removal rate make it ideal for industrial-scale drying.
  • How does the vacuum airflow improve drying? Vacuum airflow promotes even moisture removal and can reduce energy consumption compared to standard airflow patterns.
  • What materials can be dried? This dryer is compatible with a wide range of products, including food, pharmaceuticals, agricultural goods, and industrial materials.
  • Is the drying process gentle on sensitive materials? The controlled 32°C air temperature and batch operation help protect delicate products from heat damage.
